title: Exactness of the constructed kernel boundary
statement: For every commutative ring R, modules M,F,N and surjective q:F → N, the map δ_q of [def-sc-p1-tor-kernel-boundary-construction] satisfies exactness of (Tor₁(q,M),δ_q) and (δ_q,inclusion tensor 1_M). This makes no naturality assertion.

proof.text: Combine the exactness assertion at Tor from the left component with the assertion at the kernel tensor from the right component by conjunction introduction.

proof_origin.note: Decomposition of the two exactness positions; both component proofs remain open. No net hole reduction.

theorem tor_kernel_boundary_construction_exact
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (F N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (q : F →ₗ[R] N) (hq : Function.Surjective q) :
    Function.Exact (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) 1).map
      (ModuleCat.ofHom q)).app M).hom (torKernelBoundary M F N q hq) ∧
    Function.Exact (torKernelBoundary M F N q hq)
      ((LinearMap.ker q).subtype.rTensor M)
